title: Watch an impaired device
description: Drop a simulated device's packets from its drawer, watch Platform health read its protocol's gap as impaired, then repair it and watch the gap return to 0 as the window slides.

steps.caption: With a simulator connected, Platform health closes the loop. Every gap reads 0 and every device is drawing its polls.
The device table is a page of rows behind a filter. Find projector-1 by name.
projector-1 is polled over snmp. Open it in its drawer on the Simulation page, on its Impairments tab.
Drop every packet toward it, in the kernel, before the simulated device sees it.
Save. The simulator applies it on its next pull.
Back on Platform health, the loop runs on. The window is the last 10 seconds on this lab.
The outpost sent snmp requests the simulator never received. The gap opens, read as impaired, not lost, and projector-1 reads impaired below.
Repair it. Every request reaches it again.
The window still holds the change, so the gap still reads impaired.
Once the window slides past the change, the gap reads 0 and its row loses its tint.
